decision_conditions: The Local Planning Authority, having regard to its own evidence and in assessing the evidence submitted by the applicant are not satisfied that the use of the property at 14 Fox Lane, London, N13 4AH constitutes a HMO (Use Class C4). On this basis the Local Planning Authority are not satisfied that the property has been occupied as a HMO (Use Class C4) for a continuous period of at least 10 years prior to the date of this application. The use is therefore not considered to be lawful under the terms of Section 191 of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by Section 10 of the Planning and Compensation Act 1991. The Local Planning Authority refuse to issue a Certificate of Lawful Development.
